description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifierURISchemeCid, which extends HTMLPurifier_URIScheme. The class appears to implement a URI scheme handler for 'cid' (content-id), probably used for validating or processing such URIs within the HTMLPurifier framework used in SuiteCRM. The class contains properties indicating whether the scheme is browsable and whether it can omit the host, and implements a validation method that clears various URI components.

classes.name: HTMLPurifierURISchemeCid
classes.description: A class extending HTMLPurifier_URIScheme to handle 'cid' URIs (content-id URLs), with specific validation logic that resets URI components.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the URI object by clearing userinfo, port, host, query, and fragment components; returns true.
